info.name: Rent Circuit
info.description: Race a token around a city loop, snap up the streets you land on and squeeze the rent out of everyone else. Build houses and hotels on a colour you have cornered, dodge the tax office and stay out of jail - the last player with money wins.
info.ruleText: Move around a 40-space loop, buy the spaces you land on and collect rent from the other players. Owning every space of one colour doubles the rent and lets you build houses and hotels, which multiply it further. Taxes, chance cards and jail get in the way. Players who run out of money retire; the last one left wins.
info.helpText:
Everyone takes a seat on the right, then somebody presses NEW GAME. Each player starts with 1500 and a token on START.

ROLL throws both dice and walks your token around the board for you. Passing START pays 200 automatically.

Landing on a free street, depot or works opens a Buy/Pass dialog. Landing on a space somebody else owns pays the rent automatically - including the doubled rent for a complete colour, the depot ladder (25/50/100/200) and the 4x/10x dice multiplier for the works.

Click one of your own spaces to build a house or a hotel (you need the whole colour, and buildings have to go up and come down evenly), to mortgage it, to lift a mortgage, or to hand it to another player. The coloured stripe along the inner edge of a space shows who owns it; a hatched stripe means it is mortgaged. The counter next to each seat shows how many spaces that player holds.

Rolling a double lets you roll again; three doubles in a row send you to jail. LEAVE JAIL spends a saved card or pays 50, and after three failed attempts the bail is paid for you.

PAY A PLAYER settles trades and debts by hand, and RETIRE hands everything back to the bank when you cannot pay. The last player still solvent wins.
info.attribution:
Layout, board, cards and coding by VTT-AI-Agent, released to the Public Domain under CC0.

The game uses no uploaded artwork: every symbol on the board, on the tokens and on the cards comes from the icon sets that VirtualTabletop already ships. The VTT symbol set and the 3D game pieces are part of VirtualTabletop itself; the remaining icons come from game-icons.net and are licensed CC BY 3.0 - clock-tower, subway-train and water-mill by Caro Asercion; arch-bridge, bank, barn, block-house, cargo-ship, castle, church, city-car, control-tower, cowboy-boot, direction-signs, factory, family-house, greenhouse, hospital, huts-village, lighthouse, louvre-pyramid, observatory, oil-pump, park-bench, pay-money, post-office, prisoner, receive-money, sailboat, saloon, shop, sitting-dog, steam-locomotive, theater and two-coins by Delapouite; cat, cut-diamond, handcuffs, key, light-bulb, return-arrow, top-hat and uncertainty by Lorc; water-drop by Sbed; airplane and open-treasure-chest by Skoll.

The library preview image is a rendering of this game's own board and is released to the Public Domain under CC0.
